entries.description: Read planning docs and confirmed the landed remediation scope for Session 1, then authored ai-assignment.md via routed analysis for the new template-scaffolding-followup-fixes set; regenerated once to align with the current orchestrator/model schema and current model names.

Backfilled dabbler-app contract fixes: aligned root/adopter/generated docs with the split scaffold, updated template metadata, pinned scaffolded Api/Shared projects to net10.0, and excluded template bin/obj content from package inputs.
Backfilled the split-topology regression gate in PackagingSmokeTests.cs so dabbler-app smoke checks now assert the web/api/shared/tests solution layout rather than only proving a build.

Backfilled CRUD remediation: public wrapper docs now use the real Dabbler.CrudSlice CLI flags, the native page template emits Services:ApiBaseUrl + ApiBaseUrl fallback + X-Internal-Api-Key + UserIdentityHandler, and the native service template emits {Entity}ApiRegistrationExtensions.cs.
Focused validation already re-run and green: fresh dotnet pack of Dabbler.Templates, custom-hive native CRUD template smoke, PackagingSmokeTests.cs (5/5), and WrapperOrchestrationTests.cs (4/4).
Routed cross-provider session verification rounds 1-3 and saved the raw reviews. Rounds 1-2 surfaced artifact-level documentation/ledger issues; Round 3 VERIFIED after those fixes landed.

Routed next-session orchestrator recommendation for Session 2. The first gemini-pro call returned a non-JSON wrapper and was retried; the second call produced the persisted claude-code / claude-opus-4-6 / medium recommendation.
Committed and pushed the Session 1 file surface, then reran the helper-driven closeout. mark_session_complete() passed all gates and flipped Session 1 closed with VERIFIED verdict.

Read Session 1 contract-review artifacts plus current dabbler-min template source (15 files), PackagingSmokeTests.cs, WrapperOrchestrationTests.cs, tools/Dabbler.CrudSlice/README.md, and the public docs (docs/getting-started.md, docs/scaffolding-templates/README.md). Confirmed Session 1 closed VERIFIED, dabbler-app already split, dabbler-min currently single-project. Router/state-file schema mismatch discovered: installed router was 0.1.1 (writes v2) while all 41 state files migrated to v4 in commit b4f3870. Operator approved upgrade; installed 0.10.0, restored v4 state from git HEAD, re-ran register_session_start preserving sessions[] history.

Routed architecture review answering the one explicit question: should dabbler-min stay single-project or split to match dabbler-app. First call returned successfully but the response was lost to an AttributeError during attribute inspection (router 0.10.0 RouteResult shape differs from 0.1.1); re-called against the corrected shape and persisted the response immediately. Verdict: Option A — keep single-project, codify it. Auto-verification of the architecture task by GPT-5-4 fired twice (advisory only, no escalation; both rounds returned ISSUES_FOUND=1 but the route() return value was unaffected).

Saved raw routed verdict + implementation outline to dabbler-min-contract-review.md. Mid-session the operator surfaced an architecture-review-board constraint requiring physically separate Web Application and Web API projects. Walked through whether the routed Option A still stands; concluded yes (because dabbler-app already provides the four-project board-compliant entry point and dabbler-min is positioned as incremental-adoption). Appended an Operator Clarification section below the raw verdict (separator + clearly-labeled) per the never-edit-verifier-output rule.

Implemented Option A across the touched surfaces. Template source: new dabbler-min/DabblerApp/README.md (3.5KB, board-constraint callout + project layout + DB/email/sign-in + before-you-deploy + CRUD wrapper same-root usage + outgrowing path), 4-line comment block at top of Program.cs declaring single-project intent. Template metadata: rewrote description, added Framework choice symbol mirroring dabbler-app exactly. Docs: replaced two scattered paragraphs in getting-started.md with a Pick-the-right-template comparison table + architecture-board callout; expanded the scaffolding-templates README same-root paragraph with explicit dabbler-min invocation guidance and a pointer to the FullPipeline_endToEnd_against_smoke_fixture regression gate. Out-of-scope-but-necessary: consumer-readiness.md test-name reference updated to match the renamed PackagingSmokeTests method.

Renamed DabblerMin_Template_InstallsAndBuildsClean to DabblerMin_Template_InstallsAndBuildsClean_SingleProjectShape and added a new helper AssertDabblerMinSingleProjectShape with positive assertions (exactly one csproj at conventional path, README emitted) and negative assertions (no *.Api.csproj, *.Shared.csproj, *.Tests.csproj, no tests/ dir, no src/ dir). Added XML doc-comment above WrapperOrchestrationTests.FullPipeline_endToEnd_against_smoke_fixture explicitly identifying it as the standing dabbler-min same-root regression gate per the routed review's recommendation.

Re-ran the focused validation bundle: tools/pack.ps1 via pwsh (Windows PowerShell 5.1 fails on the #requires PSVersion 7 directive), then targeted dotnet test invocations. Results: PackagingSmokeTests.DabblerApp_Template_InstallsAndBuildsClean PASS (5s), DabblerMin_Template_InstallsAndBuildsClean_SingleProjectShape PASS (3s), PackOutput_ContainsAllRequiredLibraryNupkgs PASS, DabblerApp_ScaffoldedBUnit_AllTestsPass PASS. All 29 Dabbler.CrudSlice.Tests pass including FullPipeline_endToEnd_against_smoke_fixture and EmitRegistrationsOnly_writes_both_helper_files_with_convention_correct_content. Inspected the rebuilt Dabbler.Templates nupkg: 74 files / 149KB uncompressed / 0 bin/obj files — Session 1 exclude finally took effect on rebuild (previous on-disk nupkg was 24MB).

Routed session-verification with ~15KB prompt covering spec compliance, implementation faithfulness, smoke-shape strength, doc unambiguity, and missed-items check. Out-of-scope disclosures included for the consumer-readiness.md scope deviation, the operator-clarification postscript discipline, the router 0.1.1 -> 0.10.0 upgrade, the nupkg size delta, and the customer-feedback source. GPT-5.4 (OpenAI, cross-provider against my Anthropic Opus) returned VERIFIED on Round 1 with zero findings across all severities. Review saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Routed next-session orchestrator recommendation for Session 3 (Remove Template Pack Warning And Close Out). Gemini Pro returned: claude-code / claude-sonnet-4-6 / low. Rationale: Session 3 is mechanical packaging cleanup + routine closeout authoring; does not require Opus-tier reasoning. Updated ai-assignment.md Session 3 block with the new recommendation alongside the original (Codex/gpt-5.4/medium) for traceability.
